products.name: Ethiopian Yirgacheffe
products.description: A bright and floral light roast from the birthplace of coffee. This exceptional bean offers delicate notes of jasmine and bergamot with a tea-like body. Perfect for pour-over brewing methods.

products.name: Colombian Supremo
products.description: A classic medium roast showcasing Colombia's finest beans. Balanced and smooth with notes of caramel and toasted nuts. An excellent everyday coffee that never disappoints.

products.name: Brazilian Santos Dark
products.description: A bold dark roast with low acidity and full body. Rich chocolate and roasted nut flavors dominate this smooth, satisfying brew. Ideal for espresso or French press.

products.name: Kenyan AA
products.description: A vibrant medium roast with bright acidity and complex fruit notes. This premium grade coffee delivers blackcurrant and wine-like characteristics with a crisp finish.

products.name: Guatemalan Antigua
products.description: Grown in volcanic soil at high altitude, this medium roast offers a rich, full body with spicy and smoky undertones. Notes of dark chocolate and subtle fruit create a complex cup.

products.name: Ethiopian Sidamo
products.description: A delicate light roast with pronounced blueberry and lemon notes. This naturally processed coffee showcases Ethiopia's unique terroir with a syrupy body and lingering sweetness.

products.name: Colombian Huila
products.description: A bright light roast from Colombia's premier coffee region. Clean and sweet with notes of red apple, honey, and a hint of citrus. Exceptional clarity and balance.

products.name: Brazilian Cerrado
products.description: A smooth medium roast with low acidity and sweet chocolate notes. This versatile coffee offers a creamy body with hints of hazelnut and brown sugar. Great for all brewing methods.

products.name: Kenyan Nyeri
products.description: An exceptional light roast with intense fruit-forward flavors. Bright acidity balanced with notes of blackberry, grapefruit, and brown sugar. A true specialty coffee experience.

products.name: Guatemalan Huehuetenango
products.description: A rich dark roast from Guatemala's highest growing region. Bold and smoky with dark chocolate and caramelized sugar notes. Full-bodied with a clean finish.

products.name: Ethiopian Harrar
products.description: A wild and exotic medium roast with distinctive wine-like qualities. Dry-processed to enhance fruity notes of blueberry and strawberry with a hint of cinnamon spice.

products.name: Colombian Nariño
products.description: A bold dark roast from Colombia's southern highlands. Rich and full-bodied with notes of dark chocolate, molasses, and roasted almonds. Low acidity with a velvety finish.

products.name: Brazilian Yellow Bourbon
products.description: A rare light roast featuring the prized yellow bourbon varietal. Sweet and delicate with notes of honey, vanilla, and stone fruit. Exceptionally smooth with a creamy mouthfeel.

products.name: Kenyan Kiambu
products.description: A unique dark roast that preserves Kenya's signature brightness. Bold yet complex with notes of dark berries, cocoa, and a hint of black pepper. Surprisingly balanced for a dark roast.

products.name: Guatemalan Atitlán
products.description: A bright light roast from the shores of Lake Atitlán. Floral and fruity with notes of orange blossom, peach, and milk chocolate. Silky body with a clean, sweet finish.

products.name: Ethiopian Guji
products.description: A captivating medium roast from the Guji zone. Natural processing brings out intense strawberry and tropical fruit flavors with a syrupy body. Floral aromatics with a long, sweet finish.

products.name: Colombian Tolima
products.description: A well-balanced medium roast with classic Colombian characteristics. Notes of caramel, red apple, and toasted almonds. Medium body with bright acidity and a clean finish.

products.name: Brazilian Mogiana
products.description: A robust dark roast from Brazil's Mogiana region. Full-bodied and bold with notes of dark chocolate, toasted nuts, and a hint of tobacco. Perfect for those who love a strong, traditional coffee.

products.name: Kenyan Murang'a
products.description: A lively medium roast with Kenya's characteristic brightness. Juicy and complex with notes of blackcurrant, tomato, and brown sugar. Crisp acidity with a wine-like finish.

products.name: Guatemalan Cobán
products.description: A distinctive medium roast from the rainy Cobán region. Full-bodied with earthy undertones and notes of cocoa, cinnamon, and dried fruit. Unique terroir creates a memorable cup.

products.name: Ethiopian Limu
products.description: An unusual dark roast that maintains Ethiopian character. Washed processing creates a clean cup with notes of dark chocolate, spice, and subtle fruit. Medium body with low acidity.

products.name: Brazilian Sul de Minas
products.description: A crowd-pleasing medium roast from Brazil's largest coffee region. Smooth and sweet with notes of milk chocolate, hazelnut, and caramel. Low acidity makes it perfect for any time of day.

products.name: Guatemalan Fraijanes
products.description: A powerful dark roast from volcanic highlands. Bold and intense with notes of dark chocolate, cedar, and a hint of smoke. Full-bodied with a long, satisfying finish.

products.name: Kenyan Embu
products.description: A spectacular light roast showcasing Kenya's finest qualities. Bright and juicy with notes of raspberry, grapefruit, and brown sugar. Complex acidity with a silky, tea-like body.
